fact_text: The analyst argues stock splits raise the number of tradable shares and let smaller investors afford high-priced stocks in small lots, which lifts market liquidity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: United Bank cut its face value from Rs 10 to Rs 5 in a split, making its shares affordable to smaller investors, and the stock rose after the split.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Kohat Cement also split its shares, as the analyst noted when listing the 2025 split wave.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Market authorities are said to want PSX market capitalisation to reach at least $100 billion, which the analyst thinks requires growth in the market values of large companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: The analyst said listings of new IPOs are too few for a developing market, and that IPOs should be increasing, as the exchange is working on it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: The analyst said BA Bio, a successful recent IPO, trades at about 38 times earnings, making a further rise difficult at that level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: BF Agro's IPO proceeds funded a Faisalabad plant after an earlier Karachi plant, and the analyst said the IPO has since succeeded.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Most recent IPOs succeeded, though one or two drew weaker demand than Secure Logistics had.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Lucky Core, formerly ICI Pakistan, was bought by the Lucky group in 2011-12 and later added pharmaceutical businesses, which the analyst read as a value investment that rose sharply.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Engro Infrastructure took on tower projects worth about 600 million, which the analyst thinks is not yet reflected in the Engro Holdings share price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why Are Companies Doing Stock Splits ? | LCI | LUCK | UBL | THCCL | IPO Success & Market Cap' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer and Fatima Fertilizer are linked to PIA privatisation dealings with the Arif Habib group, as the analyst described them.

fact_text: Hub Power is among the listed companies involved in a consortium-financed project, which Meezan Bank leads as the lead bank.
